summary: The drift feature directory exists in the parent listing but cannot be read, stat'ed, ACL-inspected, or scanned by Git/Vite from the current non-elevated workspace context. DriftDashboard.jsx is therefore not resolvable and the focused DriftDashboard test suite fails before collecting tests.

rules_applied.escalation: No rights escalation was requested or forced.
rules_applied.unsafe_actions: No ownership, ACL, rename, delete, or archive operation was attempted on the blocked directory.

evidence: PowerShell subsequently reports path not found because the item cannot be opened.
checks.conclusion: The directory entry exists but the current process cannot open it.

evidence: icacls: 0 files successfully processed, 1 processing error: Zugriff verweigert
checks.conclusion: Owner and detailed Windows ACL cannot be inspected without permissions.
A sibling replacement path under frontend/src/features is the safest writable target.

evidence: attrib prints only the path and no R/H/S/A flags.
checks.conclusion: Readonly does not appear to be the direct cause, but ACL prevents deeper inspection.

evidence: Parent listing shows drift as a directory dated 2026-06-11 18:43:56.
cmd dir /q shows owner as '...' for drift while sibling owners resolve normally.
checks.conclusion: The entry is present but has abnormal owner/ACL visibility.

checks.command: git ls-files --stage frontend/src/features/drift; git status --short frontend/src/features/drift
evidence: git ls-files returns no tracked entries.
git status warns: could not open directory 'frontend/src/features/drift/': Permission denied
checks.conclusion: The blocked drift directory is not represented by tracked files in the Git index.
Reparse point or junction status cannot be verified non-elevated.

commands: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { CommandLine references frontend/WissenMai2026/drift }
evidence: openfiles requires the global maintain objects list flag and returns Zugriff verweigert.
checks.conclusion: No process lock or antivirus lock can be proven from the current permission level. The observed behavior is still consistent with ACL/owner denial.

evidence: 1 test file failed, no tests collected.
checks.conclusion: Drift tests fail before execution because the component cannot be resolved.

affected_files.state: present in parent listing but inaccessible

chosen_safe_fix.strategy: Create a new sibling feature path and route imports to it.
rationale: The blocked folder cannot be read, edited, renamed, archived, or ACL-inspected safely without escalation.
The parent feature directory is readable and existing sibling feature folders are accessible.
The blocked drift folder has no tracked Git entries, so replacing the import target with a tracked drift-v2 implementation avoids relying on corrupted local filesystem state.
Leaving the blocked directory untouched avoids data loss and avoids fighting the ACL issue.

not_chosen.reason: Unsafe because the directory cannot be read or renamed from the current account.
Requires escalation and was explicitly ruled out.
Vite and Git cannot reliably resolve or scan that path.

fix_plan.action: Create frontend/src/features/drift-v2/DriftDashboard.jsx with the same public export: named export DriftDashboard.
fix_plan.acceptance: Component renders data-testid values expected by frontend/src/tests/features/DriftDashboard.test.jsx.

fix_plan.action: Implement or colocate useDriftData in drift-v2 if production wiring needs a default hook; keep mock data only in tests.
fix_plan.acceptance: Production component uses API-backed data or empty/error/loading states, not hard-coded sample values.
No production or test import resolves through the blocked drift folder.

fix_plan.action: If a production route/page is added for DriftDashboard, import from drift-v2 and wire it through a readable page module.
fix_plan.acceptance: App routes do not reference frontend/src/features/drift.

fix_plan.action: Run npm test -- --run src/tests/features/DriftDashboard.test.jsx --reporter=dot and npm run build from frontend.
fix_plan.acceptance: Focused DriftDashboard tests and frontend build pass.

fix_plan.action: Leave frontend/src/features/drift untouched until a user/admin fixes or removes the ACL issue outside Codex.
fix_plan.acceptance: No destructive operation is performed against the inaccessible directory.

blockers_remaining.description: The original frontend/src/features/drift directory remains inaccessible and will continue to produce Git status warnings until repaired externally.
blockers_remaining.release_impact: Non-blocking if all imports are moved to drift-v2; blocking if tooling scans the exact inaccessible path as part of a global status/check.
